notes.title: Marvel's Midnight Suns June 2023 Update
notes.content:
Please make sure to restart your game to ensure that you’ve downloaded the latest version and continue to submit any bug reports to support.2k.com.


GENERAL
- Stability & performance improvements
- Mission cards can now be added to the hand even when there are the maximum number of cards present in the hand
- Fix for Mission Rewards not showing on Victory Screen
- Hero Deck screen now properly checks for new collar and suit passives
- Charlie's stats will now scale properly with the Hunter's Champion Level stat bonuses
- Charlie navigation improvements for the Abbey
- "Upgrade ability" objective during "No Place Like Home" mission now completes when any ability is upgraded
- Fix for achievements / trophies not being rewarded as intended


HEROES
- Venom Combos will now consume Ravenous 


NEW GAME+
- Fixed reported issue of Nest Mother and Summoning Circle missions not appearing during Act 1 of NG+ campaigns
- Toggles have been added to customize the New Game+ experience and choose progression to carry over!
- Hero Abilities: Includes hero cards and abilities, including Hunter Collars and Passives
- Friendship Levels: Includes hero and team friendship levels and rewards
- Resources: Includes Credits, Essence, Blueprints, Intel, Gloss, and Arcane Knowledge
- Cosmetics: Includes unlocked cosmetics, with purchased cosmetics immediately available


STEAM DECK
- Steam Deck performance & stability improvements

notes.title: An Update from the Dev team
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for their patience while the team continues to investigate issues that some of you have reported or may be experiencing. We will be releasing an upcoming patch that helps address some of the general performance and stutters; we'll have full details available later. In the meantime, we wanted to answer some questions we've seen about Steam Deck compatibility and related issues around Cloud Saves:
[list]
[*] [b]Steam Deck compatibility[/b]: Marvel's Midnight Suns does not feature optimizations for Steam Deck at the moment and is not verified for the platform. It is something we are investigating and will share further news once available.
[*] [b]Cloud Saves[/b]: Related to above, some users have reported issues when it comes to their cloud saves transferring across PC and Steam Deck. This is something we are investigating as part of our broader look into Steam Deck optimizations.
[/list]
Thank you again for your patience – the team is working hard to make sure you have a great [i]Marvel’s Midnight Suns[/i] experience on PC!

notes.title: An Update from the Dev Team
notes.content:
The team is aware of and working toward a solution on some general performance and framerate issues that users may be experiencing. We are also investigating reports of issues with Cloud Saves. Finally, a note that we are not optimized for the Steam Deck at the moment.

Thank you all for your patience while we work on these issues and hope to get you all an update as soon as we can.

notes.title: Firaxis Live Streams: Rise Up With The Midnight Suns!
notes.content:
With the December 2 release of Marvel's Midnight Suns fast approaching, members of the Firaxis development team recently took time out of their busy schedules to appear on a series of live streams. The ensuing card-based combat during [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/gameplay/tactical-missions/]tactical missions[/url] afforded great opportunities to see [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/heroes]heroes[/url] including [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/heroes/blade/]Blade[/url], [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/heroes/magik/]Magik[/url], [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/heroes/wolverine/]Wolverine[/url], and others show off their skills on the battlefield and learn more about the numerous activities that you can enjoy in and around [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/the-abbey]the Abbey[/url] between battles. 

If you missed out on any of the action-packed gameplay and developer insights that were shared during these live streams, you can watch archives of all four below.
 
[h2]Live Stream #4[/h2]
Hulk is shown for the first time after being revealed as the 13th (late-game unlockable) hero on the base game's Midnight Suns roster, and Creative Director Jake Solomon attempts to beat a tactical mission on the hardest of Marvel's Midnight Suns' eight difficulty settings. 

[previewyoutube=q8M1_JsU8AE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Live Stream #3[/h2]
Members of the Firaxis development team share a first look at some of the activities you can enjoy when you're not battling Lilith's demonic forces. Also, Senior Franchise Producer Garth DeAngelis almost gets beaten at his own game while playing through one of three very different tactical missions.  

 [previewyoutube=N_7xlhN34ts;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Live Stream #2[/h2]
Join the Firaxis developers for a deep dive into strategic combat as they play through tactical missions and discuss how heroes and their respective [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/gameplay/hero-abilities/]ability cards[/url] can be upgraded as you progress through the game. Later, Deadpool, Venom, Morbius, and Storm are revealed as the four heroes joining the roster in the Season Pass DLC next year.

 [previewyoutube=diwl2GrC4FI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Live Stream #1[/h2]
Creative Director Jake Solomon and Senior Franchise Producer Garth DeAngelis play through two tactical missions while discussing combat mechanics, how the Midnight Suns roster was chosen, why heroes' abilities are represented by cards, and more. 

[previewyoutube=5ZXuxi70d70;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ghost Rider (Robbie Reyes) Character Deep Dive
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.prgloo.com/media/2c22bc809e264d3e80f09291b5b588a6.png?width=1200&height=1800[/img]

[h2]Story[/h2]
Robbie Reyes grew up in a vibrant but under-resourced neighborhood in East Los Angeles. The triumphs and challenges he experienced helped him develop a firm sense of his priorities: family, friends, and customized hotrods. Most important in the “family” category will always be his disabled brother, Gabe, who Robbie helped raise, however, his other priorities were forced to shift when Robbie became possessed by the Spirit of Vengeance.

Many young men have played host to this hell-fueled alter-ego; Robbie is the latest and won’t be the last. When the Spirit takes over, Robbie transforms into Ghost Rider and becomes obsessed with punishing the wicked and inflicting brutal justice on those who do evil. His actions as Ghost Rider often leave Robbie confused and conflicted about his inner darkness and the costs of being a hero. One thing he never complains about, however, is driving Ghost Rider’s vehicle: a souped-up muscle car appropriately called the Hellride.

[h2] Specialty: Damage [/h2]
Ghost Rider can deal above-average damage, but his abilities come at a cost to himself and his allies. To mitigate some of this sacrifice, Ghost Rider is able to regain health by consuming the Souls of enemies he knocks out.

[previewyoutube=AxDSEl-JClU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Sister Grimm (Nico Minoru) Character Deep Dive
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.prgloo.com/media/8a338a740c0f4eaf8d3f1e51be4b0095.png?width=1200&height=1800[/img]

[h2]Story[/h2]
Nico Minoru was raised in an affluent Japanese-American family devoted to charity…or so she thought. In truth, to Nico’s horror, her parents were powerful sorcerers and members of a villainous organization called the Pride. After witnessing them murder a young girl, Nico allied with the other teenaged children of the Pride, disowned her parents, and ran away from home.

The depths of her parents’ corruption was revealed when Nico tried to rescue a friend captured by the Pride: her own mother tried to kill her by stabbing Nico with a magical staff. However, instead of being wounded, Nico’s body absorbed the weapon, removing it from her mother’s control as the teen’s own affinity for dark magic revealed itself for the first time. She is now a witch with near-boundless powers...except that her magic can be chaotic and unpredictable. Her powers bend to her will, preventing her from hurting an ally or healing an enemy, but precision can be challenging.

[previewyoutube=qboSZypFaow;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h2]Specialty: Support[/h2]
Nico’s abilities generate large amounts of Heroism while keeping allies healed and ready to fight. Her attacks are some of the most damaging in the game, but enemies are generally targeted randomly and cannot be selected.

[previewyoutube=lkMGgqwF9Wc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Blade Character Deep Dive
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=G1J5M3ohlSY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Story[/h2]
Called “Daywalker,” Blade is a dhampir: a half-human, half-vampire hybrid with the strength, stamina, and senses of a vampire and the sunlight tolerance of a human. A creature of the underground, Blade patrols the city’s rain-slicked alleys, abandoned warehouses, and secret nightclubs in the name of one obsessive mission: eradicate the undead from the world of the living.

This single-minded determination was born of tragedy: Blade’s human mother was murdered by a vampire’s bite during his birth. This heartbreak gave Blade the innate gifts that have allowed him to become a living weapon. Blade has used his enhanced abilities to master nearly every martial art and weapon form known to humankind, though he often favors the smooth speed of the katana.

[previewyoutube=8sE6SWJmJ2c;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h2]Specialty: Damage[/h2]
Blade is able to deal vast amounts of devastating damage with grace and agility, easily alternating between ranged and melee attacks to dominate the battlefield. Especially effective are his abilities to inflict lifesteal and damage-over-time effects on enemies, healing himself while slowly and consistently draining the lifeforce from foes. A true predator knows not only survival, but also patience.

[previewyoutube=HbEJs4l10xs;full][/previewyoutube]
